title: Intent before implementation
purpose: Ground agents in interpreted user intent and tier evidence before writes; clarify when ambiguous; avoid literal whack-a-mole fixes.

rules.humanFacing: README and command operator intros only when the user asked; do not rewrite README on agent-only harness tasks

actionOpen: If docClose.pending is true, run jq-helpers set_last (and append_research if .cursor/ was touched) before claiming done.
State interpreted intent, INDEX/l0 evidence, confidence: high | medium | low.
Low confidence: Blocking + Questions only; no writes until user answers.
Progressive research: INDEX then at most one l1 and one l2; append log.research[] each step.
If tiers leave ambiguity: clarify (Blocking / Questions / Context); do not guess.
After edits: log.last, current.json, tiers, manifest if harness changed.

confidence.medium: Prefer clarifying questions; proceed only if harm is low and user constrained scope (e.g. explicit 'implement the plan').
confidence.low: Hard stop: no writes or destructive commands until user answers.

proceed: User attached approved plan and said implement it.
User gave exact file list and success criteria.
Trivial typo fix with path and expected string provided.
mustAsk: Success criteria undefined for a new feature.
User keyword matches a familiar pattern but INDEX anchor unclear.

clarifyFormat.questions: Numbered asks; as many as needed.
clarifyFormat.context: Optional tradeoffs; not mixed into Questions.

whackAMole.afterFailure: Stop same path; log research result blocked with wrong assumption.
whackAMole.thirdLiteralAttempt: No further edits until user confirms direction.
